review_description: The quoting process was thorough. They explained each process.The installation was great. They were punctual, polite and very professional.The customer service was fantastic.They explained everything.
Great installers and installation! Great installers and installation! Great installers and installation!

The whole sales & quoting process was amazing especially with the great friendly and helpful advice from Peter miller . The installation was done very quickly and professionally. Customer service was excellent everything was done well above my expectations. Such a professional outfit , very happy with this product and company.

Obtaining the quote and proceeding through to installation was made very easy under the guidance of  Mark from Solar Power Ballarat.     Once the paperwork was completed it was only a short while later that we were contacted to arrange installation.    We were very impressed with the professionalism of the crew that attended to the installation as they were punctual, polite, friendly and very tidy.     Overall we have been very impressed with the whole procedure and very happy with the solar.

The sales process was very helpful, Pete answered all my questions and gave me different options. I am happy with the design and quality, and the install looks attractive. The install on the day was very quick. After all the government incentives, I was very pleased with the price.

Super friendly and knowledgeable. Very helpful every step of the way. Installers were very professional and did a very high quality install.Everything was set up after the install by them. Extremely easy process. Very happy. Would highly recommend.
Great work, great system, thanks for everything. Super fast from quote to install.
Excellent, friendly and high attention to detail. Would recommend the supplier/ installer

Their quote was prompt and the best value for money, when asked questions they were answered clearly. The installation team were on time and their work of a high quality and they were happy to answer any questions re the install, being on a new build the opportunity to install the feed cables in the wall cavity was a challenge they took with enthusiasm.The whole process was made easy with the help of Pete Miller from Champion from purchase to ticking all the boxes required for the connection and commissioning.

Sales and quoting were very responsiveThe insallation team were very polite and tuned up on time and cleaned all the rubbish up, only thing they did not tell me that they broke the cover on the fuse pannel.Customer service from the office was very good ,but still waiting for wifi to be connected.

Installers were in the neighbourhood the day prior to my install date. They stopped in and were able to complete the installation that day. Effective use of time by installation team cutting down travel time.

I chose Champion Energy to do my Solar Installation, they are a local company to me. Peter at Champion Energy went above and beyond helping me with the rebate documentation. The quote I was given was very reasonable and the quality of the equipment was excellent for the cost.Once the rebate was approved the installation time was brought forward.The installation was done very efficiently, and the system was signed off by the electrical consultant the same day.Champion energy arranged the grid connection after installation.The whole process was very easy . I would be very happy to recommend them to anyone looking to have solar installed.
The customer service was excellent, they organised the grid connection within 24hrs of the installation. The installation was checked and passed inspection the same say the system was installed.

Soon after requesting quotes, I was contacted by a local supplier. The salesman was very easy to deal with, and was very patient with my enquires. I was very impressed with the local crew that installed the system. They were efficient, polite, and the finish of their work was very good.  The turn around from enquiry to installation was very quick and easy.

I have my installation completed and waiting for it to be inspected. Everything went well and Champion Energy organised everything and Livewire Electrical were very good and explained all the procedures etc. Kylie and Chelsea were very efficient and nothing was too much trouble.
Everything ran like clockwork, with no concerns through the process. Will be m first choice down the track if I decide to install extra panels or a battery.

Mark had a really decent price, but also he was really honest with me. We’ve been saving up for this so had a bit of money stashed away, so I wanted a really good system. One of the other suppliers tried to sell me something that was double the price and I asked Mark about it. He had it in stock but told me it wouldn’t suit what we needed. He said he could put it in but it would be a waste. He sold us a really decent system, at a good price, when he could have taken a lot of money off us. Then Kylie and her crew from Livewire in Ballarat came round and did a great job on the installation. Said she’d be there at 8, pulled up right on time and was on the roof by 8:03. Done by 1:30, place was spotless when they left. Could not recommend either more highly

Pete the salesperson listened to me and having previously had solar in another house I knew a bit about the products and knew what I wanted, and I also checked the reviews on solar quotes review pages.  The solar installers were great (Livewire in Ballarat) worked nonstop all day, cleaned up after themselves, were punctual, tidy and pleasant to deal with.  Would go through this company again.  The installers made sure I had the app working on my phone and that it was all in working order.

From the first contact, numerous phone calls and emails and discussions about options, to the smooth and efficient installation of the system this has been a remarkably simple process. Everyone has been helpful and always made me feel like they had my best interests at heart.  I'd recommend this whole process to anyone.

Quoting - Pete was friendly and knowledgeable. He answered all our questions and was able to provide a solution that perfectly fit our requirements. Everything he promised was delivered on time as explained.Installation - Another painless process, if you exclude the weather issues the installers had to contend with (so much rain). Kylie and her team were absolutely amazing, due to their hard work the system was mostly installed in a day. I cannot compliment these electricians enough, what a superb installation team!Post-installation - A time that sorts out the wheat from the chaff. We had an issue once it was all 'switched on' with system 'tripping out'. Pete arranged for Tony to come and sort them out immediately. This took a few visits over several days but was dealt with without complaint to our complete satisfaction.Now we have a 10KW system working like a dream, and a month after instal a follow up from Pete to make sure everything is going well still.It was refreshing to have a business do the 'hard yards' dealing with our energy provider and doing all the background work. All we had to do was pay for the system and enjoy the rewards. We were constantly updated with the process by Peter so there was never any angst about when it would all happen.

We contacted Champion Energy in the middle of June 2022 and the installation was completed on 1st August. We received a proposal which included pictures of where the panels were to be located on the roof, along with a quote for the installation.We then met with Mr. Mark Smith at our home, when he went through the quote and the process with us. We found him very professional and extremely helpful.Having received three quotes for solar panels, and having decided we would accept the quote from Champion Energy, we signed the contract whilst Mr. Smith was at our home.Once the contract was signed, Mr. Smith assisted with all the necessary applications with the energy providers and the Government Departments. He then contacted us, advising of the installation date, and the panels were installed on 1st August.The installation was trouble free and the installers were most co-operative. The installation was completed in one day.Champion Energy arranged for the inspection of the installation, and in fact the inspector came the very next day.They also followed up the connection to the grid. We have since received all the necessary documentation for the installation.

The entire process was very easy after you provided the initial contact.  Peter Miller the salesperson was very helpful, he provided all information and kept in contact.  He did assist with the grid connection. The installation was quick and efficient.  We are very happy.

Dealing with Mark from Solar Power Ballarat was a flawless experience. From the quote, through to the install and final inspection, everything was smooth sailing. The installers turned up bang on time and were great to deal with, the install was quick and everything was done very neatly. The electrical inspector was out a couple of days later to do the final check.

Great service from courteous staff for quote and assistance with rebate applications. Polite, punctual staff including the installation team.Still waiting for the inspection for the grid connection but only been 5 days since installation.
Great company to deal all dates met all questions were answered promptly.

The advice we got from Pete was very clear and useful. He was very responsive to our requests.The price was reasonable and the installation was well handled by the electricians.We've just had the inspector complete his work so we're just waiting to receive the electrical safety certificate.All on all a good experience.

What a great job Mark followed up from start to finish,quotes,supply final install,with Rene and his team the install was done on time and the finish perfect,the inspection punctual.And Mark organised the grid connection.We have had the system on for the last six months and all our own power.We would and will recommend Champion energy to all.Thank you Fred,Mark,Rene and your team.Derek and Shirley Allen.

The quoting process was pretty straightforward. My “cheaper” quote company couldn’t actually come onsite to quote due to scheduling difficulties (my fault, not theirs), and had to do a remote quote. This might have resulted in their quote being one of the highest. We went with the company who had the time to sit down with us over the phone and answer all of our questions.We have a terracotta tile roof, and I had read that heavy installers are prone to breaking tiles. My installer was an all-girl team (several of them were teen-aged apprentices) and they were fantastic! Very professional and they did very tidy work. Our power box is an organised delight, and the panels are nicely arranged.The process isn’t finished yet, as lockdown 4.0 has gotten ion the way, but it’s been clearly explained a couple of times, and I expect we’ll be up and running shortly.
Solar Panel shopping was intense at times. Mark answered all of my questions in a patient manner. Thank you
Pete from Champion Energy was fantastic to deal with. He was patient and helpful, explaining the process step by step and helping me to compare brands and prices. The install was quick and painless

Sales/quoting was excellent and very helpful, explained and answered all my questions very detailed email with quote assisted with application for rebate.The installers were Polite, Punctual and explained about inspector and using the unit. Very helpful.The customer Service was better then I would have expected, There have been follow up calls and I was kept up to date with process from start to finish. Even with delays due to Covid restrictions in place always a call, email or text.Would highly recommend Pete from Champion for all solar needs.

Pete from Ballarat Solar (Champion Energy) was fantastic. He was more than happy to help me through all my questions, walk me through the process and keep me updated along the way about timelines. Install timeframes from signing were quick. Kylie and her all female crew from Livewire Electrical Ballarat were fantastic, turned up on time and did a great professional job. Very happy with everyone involved including Solar quotes. Highly recommend. This was not my cheapest quote, but the friendly and helpful attitude and staff sold me to go with them and i wasn't disappointed

Let down by dreadful customer service. Installed by a good subcontractor, but supplier was unable to make inverter fully operational.Told me I had to work it out with the inverter manufacturer. Supplier insisted on full payment, even though they accepted it was not fully operational. The manufacturer eventually managed to configure the inverter remotely after I managed to connect it to the Internet.

How was the sales/quoting process? Was a fairly streamline workflow. Lot of online paper work to get through , but fairly straight forward. The sales quote was good. Suggest some customer service improvement in the follow up process.  But nothing that was concerning.How did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual? Yes it was very efficient and on time to make a start. Completed within half a day. Completely open, knowledgeable and helpful installers.How was the customer service? e.g. did they help organise the grid connection after the install? It has been two weeks and the process of inspection, paperwork has been submitted. Still on going with the process at this time.
Little problems with upgrade of switchboard upgrade ,due to COVID lockdown delaying finale authorisation , but all done  and working connected to grid very happy with all who we’re involved.
All well done, except it took a while to get the Wi-Fi connection working
Very happy with installer and the whole process. They took care of the connection to the grid and kept me advised of the progress.
